_comment: GUI apps measured by scripts/gui_ram_audit.py, in addition to hcs-gui-shots. Each app must expose a headless mode so its RSS can be sampled without a display. Budget: 250 MB per app (v2 plan §6).
_headless_note: These binaries fall back to a non-GUI path when WAYLAND_DISPLAY and DISPLAY are both unset, so the audit measures the real process rather than a stub. --hold-seconds keeps each one alive long enough to be sampled.

apps.name: hcs-fm
apps.note: file manager: listing, filter pills, date narrowing, preview pane

apps.name: hcs-term
apps.note: terminal: profile search and grid rendering

apps.name: hcs-notes
apps.note: notes: Markdown store with offline search

apps.name: hcs-actions
apps.note: action registry: ranking, quick keys, privileged-action gating

apps.name: hcs-update
apps.note: level-based update manager: risk levels, snapshots, rollback plan

apps.name: hcs-persist
apps.note: amnesic session and persistent storage state machine

apps.name: hcs-recall
apps.note: local timeline: credential and payment filtering before storage
